EmailTemplate.subject: How to address affordability the easy way
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Providers across the country are looking to leverage technology to manage payments, financial care, and transparency for patients while meeting their digital needs.
Thanks to this article <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/15-must-know-trends-in-healthcare-payments/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> with 15 key stats from Beckers, we know the key statistics that matter – like 9 out of 10 patients want to know their payment responsibility up-front. There are few solutions that work and can scale rapidly to keep up with new technology demands. Fewer solutions exist that have been proven to provide the financial care and transparency patients call for. The time is now to create a successful strategy that addresses the issue.
If you’re not sure how to get started, please reach out. At Flywire, our technology has been proven to double patient satisfaction with their billing experience and fight delayed payments with an average 15% increase in collections.
